findings.text: python -m reckon.crew.paid_lanes --once never reads its command line: the __main__ stanza calls main() with no argv and main() reads a missing argv as an empty list, so --path, --project and --checkout-path are inert. Measured from the reviewed tree: with --once --path /tmp/paid-lanes-probe.json the command wrote /home/ITER/mcintos/public/reckon/paid-lanes.json carrying 10 accounts, every window unknown, exit 0, and never created the named path; the same call in-process with --project reckon produced observations for 6 of 10 accounts from the receipt, rollout and stream sources, so the gathering works and only the argv plumbing is broken. The deferred five-minute timer runs exactly this form, so the deployment the evidence record leaves open cannot publish a reading for any backend.

the document-reading branch is unreachable from production: reckon/cli.py:964 and reckon/mcp.py:3497 both pass windows=recorded_windows(...), so the published document has no production reader at this head and the plan's "Preflight and dispatch read that document" is not yet true; this is the declared out-of-scope boundary, recorded as a follow-on and material to whether the section's done-when is met.

gather_sources, the production gatherer every command reading comes from, is reached by no test: the gate's "a reading for each of the three backends" is asserted against Candidate objects the test injects at tests/test_paid_lanes_document.py:113, so a regression in the receipt, rollout or stream wiring reddens nothing.

a library call now reads a workstation-global file: absent an explicit windows argument budget.preflight reads ~/public/reckon/paid-lanes.json, and 51 calls in tests/test_budget.py plus 6 in tests/test_coordinator_reserve.py pass no windows and isolate nothing, so their result depends on a file outside the repository under test; a document naming those backends moved no test result when I measured it (identical FAILED sets with a document naming alpha and beta), so the exposure is latent rather than currently biting.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from base 02e2757d; db50a1e3 adds reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py (523 lines), 36 lines in reckon/budget.py and 293 test lines, and 559e9fe7 adds the plan paragraph (11 insertions, no deletions), the cumulative evidence record and the figure.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_paid_lanes_document.py for four document-level properties plus a zero-added-failure suite delta; the manifest records that gate and its result, re-running it from the reviewed tree reproduces 6 passed in 0.39s, and the recorded base/head FAILED sets are identical.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is paid-backend headroom published as one document the pre-flight reads; reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:234 composes it and reckon/budget.py:1476 reads it, but the shipped command cannot name a project, so the document its documented invocation publishes carries a reading for no backend.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the gate command and result, the three log paths, the negative control's mutation and red output, and the base/head suite results; every claim I rechecked (gate result, failure sets, commit list, tree cleanliness) held.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the six declared paths hold every path either commit touches, verified with git show --numstat over 02e2757d..559e9fe7, and the reviewed worktree is clean at its head.

justifications.durability: the four document properties carry litmus-tested assertions, but reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:382 (gather_sources) is reached by no test and the untested entry point carries a live defect.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_paid_lanes_document.py:246 pins the document-to-pre-flight agreement and its negative control reddens it, but tests/test_paid_lanes_document.py:288 hands main() an argv list, so no test can see the command-line path the record's own invocation names.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:74 reuses window_reading and the pre-flight's own readers and follows the module idiom, and the four new constants duplicate budget.py:1596-1597 rather than sharing them, a nit rather than a defect.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:523 calls main() with no arguments, so the documented python -m reckon.crew.paid_lanes --once publishes ten accounts whose every window is unknown, measured from the reviewed tree.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in both commits lies inside the six declared write paths, and the plan paragraph is 11 insertions with the meta lines reverted as follow_ons records.
